releaseTitle: ATalk v3.2.2 — Read Receipts (Double/Blue Ticks), Chat Previews, 8-Digit OTP & Stealth Notification Disguises
releaseNotes:
• Read Receipts & Status Ticks: Full delivery tracking with single grey tick (Sent), double grey tick (Delivered), and cyan double tick (Read).
• Live Chat Previews & Indicators: Chat list shows rich previews (Voice message, Location, Photo, Document) and instant outgoing delivery ticks.
• 8-Digit Cryptographic OTP: Upgraded email linking and authentication verification from 6-digit to high-entropy 8-digit OTP.
• 5 Stealth Notification Disguises: Selectable disguise personas in Settings (Android System & Battery, Calendar & Schedule, Stealth Haptic Pulse, Courier Tracking, Chess Tactics, or Disabled) to keep private chats fully hidden on lock screen.
